telemetry_log.prompt_preview: Audit Build 24: 1) App crashed multiple times on first open; 2) When Live Lyrics is toggle
telemetry_log.response_preview:
Confirmed. First-open crash matches an unguarded cold-start path — likely force unwrap or unchecked decode around activity/snapshot state — with no catch/log to surface it.

The sync issue is the pin default: `NowPlayingCoordinator.pin = .appleMusic` prevents observing the active Spotify source, so Live Lyrics won’t track until the user manually re-enters/activates Spotify. Fix by defaulting to `.auto` or observing `activePlayingSource` and updating `pin` when it changes.
